rca_of_issue: CORS blocking issue: Frontend at https://vocabist-restore.preview.emergentagent.com attempts to fetch https://vocabist-restore.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login. Browser receives CORS error: 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header has value 'https://vocabist-audit.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud' that does not match the supplied origin. Root cause: Kubernetes ingress or proxy layer is setting CORS headers that override the FastAPI CORSMiddleware configuration. Backend correctly returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' when tested with curl, but browser receives different header value. This is an infrastructure/deployment configuration issue, not a code issue. Mitigation: Configure Kubernetes ingress to either (1) allow all origins with '*', or (2) specifically allow the frontend preview URL, or (3) ensure FastAPI CORS headers are not overridden by proxy layer.
